findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe pickle deserialization in pydantic
 * @description Using pickle.load/loads with untrusted input can lead to arbitrary code execution
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/unsafe-pickle-deserialization
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-502
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall()
select call, "Potentially unsafe pickle deserialization that could execute arbitrary code."
findings.hypothesis: Unsafe pickle deserialization could lead to arbitrary code execution (CWE-502)

message.text: Potentially unsafe pickle deserialization that could execute arbitrary code.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Code injection via eval/exec
 * @description Using eval or exec with untrusted input can lead to arbitrary code execution
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/code-injection
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-094
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("builtins").getMember(["eval", "exec"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("__builtins__").getMember(["eval", "exec"]).getACall()
select call, "Potentially unsafe code execution via eval/exec."

message.text: Potentially unsafe code execution via eval/exec.
